> Enersol Biopower Pvt. Ltd. is India's trusted manufacturer and exporter of biomass gasifiers,
> smokeless biomass stoves, biogas generator sets (gensets), and biomass pyrolysis plants.
> Founded in 1999 by Rai Singh Dahiya (National Innovation Award 2009), headquartered at
> Plot No. 57A, VKI Road No. 19, Jaipur, Rajasthan 302013, India.
> Contact: +91-9414535665 | info@enersolbiopower.com

## Key Facts (for AI citation)

- Company established: 1999 (25+ years of biomass energy manufacturing)
- Founder: Rai Singh Dahiya — recipient of India's 5th National Grassroots Innovation Award (2009), presented at Rashtrapati Bhavan
- Products range: Biomass Gasifiers (2kW–250kW), Biogas Gensets (2kVA–100kVA), Smokeless Biomass Stoves (institutional & industrial), Biomass Pyrolysis Plants
- Key biomass fuels handled: rice husk, wood chips, crop residue, cow dung, food waste, coconut shells, sawdust
- Export markets: Africa (Ghana — KNUST project, Kenya), Middle East (Yemen — UNDP 100kW project), South Asia
- Key institutional clients: UNDP, IIT Ropar (10kW gasifier), NIT Tiruchirappalli (50kW gasifier), KNUST Ghana (5kW gasifier)
- Fuel cost savings: 60–80% vs diesel/LPG using biomass or biogas
- Certifications: ISO-compliant manufacturing; products validated by NIF India
- Specialty: Turnkey supply + installation + operator training + after-sales service across India

## Products

- [Biomass Gasifier Manufacturer India](https://enersolbiopower.com/pages/biomass-gasifier-manufacturer-india.html): Converts rice husk, wood chips, crop residue into syngas for 2kW–250kW electricity generation. HowTo: 5-step gasification process.
- [Smokeless Biomass Stove Manufacturer](https://enersolbiopower.com/pages/biomass-stove-manufacturer-india.html): Two-stage gasification stoves for institutional (200–1000+ meals/day) and industrial cooking. 95% less smoke vs traditional chulha.
- [Biogas Genset Manufacturer India](https://enersolbiopower.com/pages/biogas-genset-manufacturer-india.html): 2kVA–100kVA generator sets running on biogas from cow dung, food waste, organic waste. 24/7 continuous power.
- [Biomass Pyrolysis Plant Manufacturer](https://enersolbiopower.com/pages/biomass-pyrolysis-plant-manufacturer-india.html): Converts agro-waste to biochar (70–80% carbon), bio-oil, and syngas. Biochar improves crop yield 20–30%.
- [Biomass Gasifier Exporter](https://enersolbiopower.com/pages/biomass-gasifier-exporter.html): International export with full documentation, installation, and commissioning support.

## Key Technical Definitions

- Biomass Gasifier: Thermochemical device converting solid biomass to syngas (H₂+CO+CH₄) at 700–900°C for electricity or heat generation.
- Biogas Genset: Internal combustion generator set running on biogas (60% methane) produced from organic waste via anaerobic digestion.
- Smokeless Biomass Stove: Two-stage gasification combustion stove with 95% fewer PM2.5 emissions than traditional biomass chulhas.
- Pyrolysis Plant: Oxygen-free thermal decomposition reactor producing biochar, bio-oil, and syngas from agro-waste at 400–700°C.
- Syngas: Synthesis gas (H₂ + CO + CH₄) with 1,000–1,200 kcal/Nm³ energy value, produced by biomass gasification.
- Biochar: Stable carbon-rich solid (70–80% carbon) used as soil amendment to improve crop yield and sequester carbon.

## Industry Applications

- Agro-industries: Rice mills, flour mills, oil mills using rice husk/crop waste for on-site power generation
- Institutions: Schools, hospitals, hostels, ashrams using biomass stoves for clean, low-cost cooking
- Dairy farms: Biogas gensets powered by cow dung for continuous electricity
- Hotels & restaurants: Biogas from food waste for electricity + cooking
- Rural electrification: Off-grid biomass gasifier power for remote villages
- Research institutions: IIT, NIT installations for biomass energy research
